chair.lede: We move the clock one second closer to midnight, driven primarily by worsening health and climate emergencies
body: Severe flooding in eastern Syria killed five children, underscoring escalating climate‑related risks.
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now surpassed 5,000 deaths, marking a deepening bio‑security crisis,,.
While AI safety steps were noted, the combined impact of these health and climate shocks outweighs modest improvements elsewhere.

experts.say: Patriot missile sales to Ukraine continue (1) while Iranian lawmakers push NPT withdrawal (11), offsetting each other with no clear net change in nuclear risk.
Severe flooding in eastern Syria killed children and storm warnings across major Australian cities signal extreme weather risks.
The Congo Ebola outbreak has killed over 5,000 people, indicating a worsening health crisis.

OpenAI reduced its funding target, limiting resources for risky scaling (9); it also restricted weapons‑related content for teen users on ChatGPT (19); the SEC is actively monitoring AI corporate disclosures (21). These steps modestly improve AI safety.

US approval of a $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine heightens military tension with Russia (1). Meanwhile a rare local cease‑fire in Russian‑occupied Oleshky allows some residents to return, offering a modest de‑escalation (29).
